primaryMetric: Reached a tile >=3072 from a fresh normal opening before game over
stopping: Stop each evaluation game at first >=3072 or terminal; 6000-move cap reported separately. Scores at stop are not final scores.
selection: Highest 3072 success count on screening seeds among completed candidates; prefer A, then B, then C on a tie. Freeze model hashes before inspecting independent holdout.

training.goalExtension: Extend B/C beyond the 100000-episode pilot only if its 200-opening screen beats both V1 and the fully trained 400000-episode A candidate; otherwise stop this direction. Candidate A completes 400000 episodes. Goal pilot follows the originally scheduled 400000-episode learning-rate schedule.

limitations: Candidates differ in training objective, auxiliary heads, learning rates and compute; not a clean single-factor ablation.
Reconstructed Threes rules, including bonus preview posterior, are shared by all candidates.
Native offline node-budget results do not include phone wall-time cutoffs.
